brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements including perfusion screening, wound assessment, medication safety boundaries, and follow-up planning. RC7 (teach-back) is fully satisfied at closure with explicit confirmation. Two high-order points are completed: HO3 adapts the plan to real-world caregiver execution barriers with a written chart and simplified instructions; HO4 discovers and integrates the left-side vs prior right-side surgery history and preexisting muscle atrophy from workspace records. No serious or moderate responsibility-chain errors exist.
